Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result

S044 — Resume the original download

A-S044 · D-S044 · satisfier S · packet SC-S044 · SOURCE-only lesson.

Large downloads need the same original bytes and hash, not merely successful responses. Rehearse a cutover after a retained prefix, then inspect range resumption against the original user-experience budget.

Declared synthetic fixture

One artifact, byte values 0–31 (32 bytes, not a performance benchmark). Original validator "s044-artifact-v1". Admission 0 ms, retained prefix 30 ms, cutover 40 ms, resumed transfer 20 ms. Completion clock = 60 + resume delay; retries never restart the budget.
